name: Claw on Claw
source:
You are in the role of Soba, a Chinese crocodile lizard and all-around claw game fiend. The game focuses around date nights with Soba's boyfriend, Graham, all of which seem to end up at the arcade's claw machine!

Win different prizes to change how the night unfolds. Try to grab them all! Get to know Graham and Soba over many dates and see where their relationship goes!

[From [url=https://douglaskim.itch.io/claw-on-claw]Itch.io[/url]]
